title: SIP instalments debited twice

acceptableCauses.mechanism: Bank northstar slowed down during the SIP batch; debit-worker's shortened confirmation timeout (2500 ms) made it resubmit debits without an idempotency key, and the bank later confirmed both.

partialCredit.reason: The bank slowdown is a contributing cause but not why debits were duplicated.

keyCounterevidence: The 05:50 IST bank-connector deploy did not slow other banks; only one bank was slow.
job-scheduler shows sip-debit-batch ran once today, unlike the past double-run incident.
notes: Slow bank: northstar from 06:40 IST to 07:55 IST.
